description: Terrain the writer cannot write, with no Geometry Coercer in front of it: GeoJSON features t1, a quad typed dem:TINRelief (rejected as citygml.tin_not_triangles), t2, a triangle typed dem:TINRelief, and r1, a triangle typed dem:ReliefFeature (rejected as citygml.relief_feature_geometry, as a ReliefFeature has no geometry property of its own). Only t2 is written, with a filled dem:lod 0; t1 and r1 are dropped whole and reported as citygml.empty_geometry too (reports are pinned by unit tests, as workflow tests compare files only). The envelope still covers the rejected features, as for any geometry dropped after conversion. New-world only: the legacy writer has no terrain support.
